RunEndRecord.description: End of a run; sent after its last data record.

v.description: Version of the schema. Increased only on breaking changes.
v.title: V

fw.description: Firmware version (optionally containing the git commit hash)
fw.title: Fw

boot.description: Boot counter, stored on flash memory of the microcontroller.
boot.title: Boot

run.description: ID of the run that starts or ends.
run.title: Run

seq.description: Sequence number per record kind, for dedup (QoS 1, SD replay) and gap detection per kind. For data it counts per run and restarts at 0 with every run; for all other kinds it counts per boot. Unique key: (dev, run, seq) for data, (dev, boot, k, seq) for all other kinds.
seq.title: Seq

up.description: Monotonic seconds since boot, ms resolution. Time of measurement/event, not of sending. Use for intervals: ts may jump on re-sync.
up.title: Up

ts.description: Unix seconds UTC after NTP sync, captured together with up. null while unsynced; key is mandatory.
ts.title: Ts

cmd_id.description: id of the cmd that stopped the run; null if not ended by a command.
cmd_id.title: Cmd Id

reason.description: Why the run ended: duration elapsed, manual stop (command or on the device), or error in the firmware. A run without an end record is marked aborted by the pipeline; the device never sends that.
reason.title: Reason

n_data.description: Number of data records produced in this run. data seq starts at 0, so the run's data seq values are 0 to n_data - 1.
n_data.title: N Data

RunEndRecord.title: RunEndRecord

v.description: Version of the schema. Increased only on breaking changes.
v.title: V

fw.description: Firmware version (optionally containing the git commit hash)
fw.title: Fw

boot.description: Boot counter, stored on flash memory of the microcontroller.
boot.title: Boot

run.description: ID of the run that starts or ends.
run.title: Run

seq.description: Sequence number per record kind, for dedup (QoS 1, SD replay) and gap detection per kind. For data it counts per run and restarts at 0 with every run; for all other kinds it counts per boot. Unique key: (dev, run, seq) for data, (dev, boot, k, seq) for all other kinds.
seq.title: Seq

up.description: Monotonic seconds since boot, ms resolution. Time of measurement/event, not of sending. Use for intervals: ts may jump on re-sync.

dur.description: Planned duration; null = unlimited, runs until stopped.

session.description: Session this run belongs to, taken from the start command; null if none.

cmd_id.description: id of the cmd that started the run; null if started on the device.
